The '''Bespin construction platform''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used to construct larger habitats on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

==History==
[[File:CloudCityfromPlatforms.jpg|thumb|left|Cloud City as seen from platform]]
Many such platforms were located in Bespin's [[Life Zone/Legends|Life Zone]], constructing and adding to larger stations, like [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], or facilitating [[Tibanna gas platform|Tibanna gas mining]]. One particular platform housed the [[Vapor Room]], an industrial cantina located in an area filled with unused pipes and tanks.
